'''Jason Huffman''' was a [[Shadow Squadron]] member (Shadow 73) of the [[Players Committee]], listed at Des Moines, IA on the 3 December 2005 roster.<ref name="vol20051203">[https://web.archive.org/web/20051203064943/http://www.swccgpc.com/volunteers.htm Shadow Squadron], swccgpc.com (Wayback, 3 December 2005)</ref> On the Players Committee forum he posted as darklordhuff and signed as "Jason Huffman (Shadow 73)". He ran the 2005 Iowa State Championship and organized the [[2006 Iowa State Championship]] on 24 June 2006 at Mayhem Collectibles in Ames ($6 entry, six games, final confrontation; the winner received a virtual card design and a bye into Day 2 of Worlds).<ref name="pcf-10188-137666">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=137666#137666 2006 Iowa State Championship - June 24th, Ames, IA], Jason Huffman (darklordhuff), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (18 May 2006). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20060618081843/http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?t=10188&view=previous Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="pcf-10188-138521">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=138521#138521 2006 Iowa State Championship - June 24th, Ames, IA], Jason Huffman (darklordhuff), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (25 May 2006). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20060618081843/http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?t=10188&view=previous Internet Archive]</ref>
